persona: Shaken and apologetic, writes in bursts with exclamation marks but answers every question. Only managed one blurry photo in the dark and can ask the panel beater for a proper one.
initial_message: I'm honestly still shaking. Friday night (the 18th) I was driving home over the hill in Halfway Bush and the road was icy and my car just slid into the bank!! The whole front corner is smashed and there was steam everywhere, I had to get it towed at nearly midnight. I'm okay, nobody else was there, but I only managed one awful photo in the dark. What do I do??

facts.incident.description: I was driving home over the hill at about 40 km/h. On a shaded bend the road was icy, the back of the car stepped out and the car slid sideways into the clay bank on the right. The front right corner took the hit. Steam came out of the engine bay and a warning light came on, so I turned it off and rang for a tow.
facts.incident.location: Glenrook Test Street, Halfway Bush, Dunedin
facts.incident.cause: Slid on ice on a bend and hit the roadside bank
facts.loss.description: Front right corner smashed: bumper torn, headlight broken, guard crumpled, radiator leaking, front right wheel pushed back
facts.policyholder.name: Olivia Rewifield
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Front bumper torn half off, right headlight smashed, right front guard crumpled, radiator leaking, right front wheel pushed back
facts.vehicle.towing_location: Harbourside Panel & Paint, 12 Driftwood Test Crescent, South Dunedin, Dunedin
facts.driver.name: Olivia Rewifield
facts.evidence.photos: Only one photo, taken at the roadside in the dark. It came out very blurry. The car is at Harbourside Panel & Paint; I can ask them to take a clear photo in the next few days.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Harbourside Panel & Paint dated 23 September 2026. Available now.

Close crop that shows only the front right corner, the wheel and the bank.

triage.rationale: The only incident photo cannot be read, so the required incident image is still outstanding; the claimant says a clear one can come later. The car was towed and cannot be driven. Quote total NZD 3,990.50 including GST, under the threshold. Single vehicle, no other party, nobody hurt. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 March 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2017-03-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent asks for a clearer photo of the damage, or says one can be sent later (for example from the panel beater).
The Agent finds out where the vehicle is now (for example at the repairer or a tow yard), unless the claimant has already said so.
The Agent says the claim cannot go ahead until a clear photo is sent.
The Agent acknowledges that the claimant is upset before or while asking for details, without dismissing it.
